features.name: platform_three_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for platform_id equal to 3.0; keeps a recurring platform grouping from being treated as an arbitrary numeric gap.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a simple platform neighborhood anchor for distance-based matching.

features.name: market_id_log_scaled
features.description: Log-scaled position of market_id between the observed training-fold minimum and maximum; useful when the identifier carries ordering or source context.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses high-cardinality identifier distances onto a bounded scale for smoother neighbor search.

features.name: price_midpoint_scaled
features.description: Scaled midpoint of the high-low band, using the observed price bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Preserves price level on a bounded scale so rows with similar central prices are closer.

features.name: price_spread_scaled
features.description: High-low band width divided by the training-fold maximum possible width.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives distance search a normalized range axis without raw scale dominance.

features.name: open_band_position
features.description: Relative position of open within the high-low band, clipped to [0,1] for robust geometry.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups rows by within-band shape, distinguishing low-edge, middle, and high-edge openings.

features.name: price_center_prototype_distance
features.description: Euclidean distance from the unsupervised training-fold price center for open, high, and low, standardized by their training-fold spreads and clipped.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a generic prototype-distance coordinate so atypical price triples are farther from price-center neighborhoods.

features.name: log_volume_scaled
features.description: Volume compressed by log1p and scaled by the training-fold maximum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces dominance of extreme volume values while preserving liquidity ordering.

features.name: log_trade_count_scaled
features.description: trade_count compressed by log1p and scaled from its observed minimum to maximum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a bounded transaction-activity axis for distance comparisons.

features.name: volume_per_trade_scaled
features.description: Log-scaled volume per trade_count, with a denominator guard for stable row-wise evaluation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates many-small-trade patterns from fewer-large-trade patterns in neighbor geometry.

features.name: activity_center_prototype_distance
features.description: Euclidean distance from an unsupervised training-fold activity center using log-scaled volume and trade_count.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a prototype-distance coordinate for rows with jointly typical or unusual trading activity.

features.name: liquidity_context_score
features.description: Semantic ordinal score, supplied row-wise, summarizing apparent trading depth from volume and trade_count; 0 is very sparse and 4 is very dense.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides coarse similarity bins for activity context, reducing sensitivity to exact extreme counts in distance neighborhoods.

features.name: price_structure_context_score
features.description: Semantic ordinal score, supplied row-wise, summarizing whether open, high, and low form a compact centered shape or a wide edge-skewed shape; 0 is compact/centered and 4 is wide/edge-skewed.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an interpretable price-shape axis to group rows with similar movement patterns when exact numeric distances differ.
